args.title: Fix the initial scheduled export not sent on the first week
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

The scheduled export for the first week was not sent due to an issue in determining the next run time. This change corrects the scheduling logic, ensuring that the export is sent as expected after its initial configuration.
